title: 第15章 柳玉姝突破

content_zh:
“嘭！”
“嘭！”
到场内，两道身影犹如两头矫健的猿猴一样，身影不断交错，每一次交错，都会有一声拳头碰撞的闷声，一声声好似平地炸雷一样响起。
一男一女，能够看得出来，是两个十六七岁的少年少女。
正是楚云凡和柳玉姝两人。
两人出手凌厉，虽然说是陪练，但是除了不下死手之外，其他的更是百无禁忌。
两人一连交手就是一刻钟以上，一般人认真打上一遍虎魔拳，都要气喘吁吁，但是他们却是体力绵长，呼吸虽然开始沉重，但是却没有力竭的样子。
与之前楚云凡因为身体素质上不如柳玉姝，所以完全被压制，但是现在却不同，两人打的有声有色，甚至楚云凡还能够反过来压制住了柳玉姝。
虽然楚云凡无论是出拳速度还是力度都还是不如柳玉姝，甚至连出拳次数都不如柳玉姝，但是每一次出拳还是能够恰好破开柳玉姝的防御圈子。
反而每每都能够打的柳玉姝一个措手不及。
在一旁的保镖一直看着，不敢放松，因为双方已经这样打上了一个多小时了，除了每隔一段时间停下来以疗伤喷剂来疗伤和休息恢复体力之外，根本没有停止的时候。
此时，柳玉姝和楚云凡的手上都出现了各种各样的血痕和淤青。
这样实战的效果也非常有效，柳玉姝本身就已经是登堂入室的巅峰了，距离炉火纯青也只差一步之遥。
而现在随着楚云凡不断出手，甚至还不断出声指点，她的破绽越来越少，甚至在招式和招式随意的更换的过程之中也没有原本的一些晦涩的感觉。
厚积薄发，在这个时候柳玉姝有了一种几乎要爆发一样的感觉。
在楚云凡的压迫之下，很多招式她都根本来不及去想如何应对，只是凭借着本能就能出手。
这是楚云凡所说的，要想跨入炉火纯青的境界必不可少的一步，不仅仅要能够熟练掌握招式，更是能够刻入本能之中。
终于，柳玉姝之前所有的积累，都已经彻彻底底的爆发了出来，将她一步带入了另外一个境界。
原本还会被楚云凡不断钻到漏洞的攻击，突然一下子都消失了，所谓的漏洞也能够随时随地补上，因为所有的招式都在她的手中掌握，信手拈来。
并没有固定施展的套路，自然也就没有那些破绽和漏洞了。

“噔噔噔！”
楚云凡被直接逼退了好几步，才稳住了身形，他脸上不惊反喜，鼓掌说道：“恭喜柳小姐虎魔拳进入炉火纯青的境界！”
柳玉姝接过一旁保镖递上的疗伤喷剂，喷洒在自己的双手之上，在雪白的手臂上的血痕和淤青看起来，是如此的骇人。
密密麻麻，到处都是！
柳玉姝在修炼之上，对自己无比的狠辣，哪怕双臂遍体鳞伤，也都没有喊过一声疼，这让楚云凡也不由得刮目相看。
她能够取得如今的成就，不只是因为出身的家世好而已。
“这都是你陪练的好！”柳玉姝说道，一张俏脸上露出了几分兴奋的神情。
不管她表现的如何沉稳，说到底也只是一个十几岁的少女而已，虎魔拳的水平更上一层楼，她的实战能力也就更上一层楼。
她有同学早在半年多前开始学的，请了那么多私教，现在也不过是炉火纯青而已，而她总共只花费了十天。
而这一切，自然要归功于楚云凡了。
“柳小姐过奖了！”
楚云凡也在喷涂疗伤喷剂，一股股清凉的感觉，代替了原本火辣辣的感觉。
柳玉姝对自己狠，哪怕双手淤青，血痕遍布，也不喊停，他这个陪练自然也不好喊停，况且在这样的战斗之中，他收获的好处也很多，原本只是刚刚突破进入到炉火纯青的境界，现在已经彻底稳固了。
现在有人能够陪着实战，还提供疗伤喷剂，还有钱赚，这是何乐而不为呢。
他一边战斗，一边提升自己，同时也有了一个很深刻的领悟，说到底，武道的修行，武技虽然重要，但是内功境界才是根本。
柳玉姝虽然压制了自己的真气，但是身体素质比他好太多了，在柳玉姝的虎魔拳也跨入了炉火纯青的境界之后，就几乎立刻就恢复了对自己的压制。
自己原本能找到破绽反击，现在根本都没了，剩下的就是硬碰硬了，而在这方面，自己还是差得远了。
“我可没有过奖，我之前也请过私教，只是私教今天请假了，没来，我回头就辞退他！”柳玉姝简单直接的说道，“我私教的水平远不如你，我之前虽然只差一步就能从登堂入室进入炉火纯青，但是现在看来，没有你陪练要跨入这一步，起码要半个月的时间，我那个私教要发现我一个明显的破绽都要用上很长的时间，在你面前，我感觉我就像是不设防的一样，所有的破绽全部都暴露出来了，发现一个解决一个，我的进步速度才会这么快！”

content_en:
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
When they entered the arena, the two figures were like two powerful apes. The figures kept intersecting. Every time they intertwined, there would be a muffled sound of fists colliding, and a sound like thunder on the ground.
A man and a woman, it can be seen that they are two boys and girls of sixteen or seventeen years old.
It was Chu Yunfan and Liu Yushu.
The two of them struck fiercely, and even though they were sparring partners, apart from not using deadly strikes, there were no other taboos.
The two of them fought continuously for more than a quarter of an hour. Most people would be out of breath after a serious attack of the Tiger Demon Fist, but they had long-lasting physical strength. Although their breathing began to become heavy, they did not appear to be exhausted.
Unlike before, Chu Yunfan was completely suppressed because he was inferior to Liu Yushu in physical fitness, but now it was different. The two fought vigorously, and Chu Yunfan was even able to suppress Liu Yushu in turn.
Although Chu Yunfan is still not as good as Liu Yushu in terms of punch speed and strength, and even the number of punches is not as good as Liu Yushu's, every punch can still break through Liu Yushu's defensive circle.
On the contrary, Liu Yushu was always caught off guard.
The bodyguards on the side kept watching, not daring to relax, because the two sides had been fighting like this for more than an hour. Except for stopping at intervals to use healing spray to heal their injuries and rest to restore their strength, there was no time to stop.
At this time, various bloodstains and bruises appeared on the hands of Liu Yushu and Chu Yunfan.
This is also very effective in actual combat. Liu Yushu is already at the peak of her career, and is only one step away from becoming a master.
But now, as Chu Yunfan continues to take action and even continues to give guidance, her flaws are getting fewer and fewer, and even in the process of randomly changing moves and moves, there is no original sense of ambiguity.
At this moment, Liu Yushu felt like she was about to explode.
Under Chu Yunfan's pressure, she had no time to think about how to respond to many moves, and could only use her instincts to execute them.
This is what Chu Yunfan said. If you want to step into the realm of proficiency, you must not only be able to master the moves skillfully, but also be able to carve them into your instincts.
Finally, all Liu Yushu's previous accumulation had completely exploded, bringing her into another realm.
Chu Yunfan's attacks that would have been exploited by loopholes suddenly disappeared. The so-called loopholes could be fixed anytime and anywhere, because all the moves were in her hands and she could easily pick them up.
There is no fixed routine, so naturally there are no flaws and loopholes.
"Ding-deng-deng!"
Chu Yunfan was forced back several steps before he stabilized his figure. His face was not surprised but happy, he clapped and said: "Congratulations to Miss Liu for entering the realm of proficiency in Tiger Demon Fist!"
Liu Yushu took the healing spray handed by the bodyguard and sprayed it on her hands. The blood marks and bruises on her snow-white arms looked so horrifying.
Densely packed, everywhere!
Liu Yushu was extremely cruel to her during her training. Even though her arms were covered with bruises, she never cried out in pain, which made Chu Yunfan look at her with admiration.
She is able to achieve what she is today not just because of her good family background.
"This is all because of your sparring!" Liu Yushu said, with a look of excitement on her pretty face.
No matter how calm she appears, in the final analysis she is just a teenage girl. As the level of Tiger Demon Fist increases to the next level, her actual combat ability will also increase to the next level.
One of her classmates started learning it more than half a year ago, and they hired so many private tutors, but now they are just perfect at it, and she only spent ten days in total.
And all of this is naturally attributed to Chu Yunfan.
"Miss Liu, thank you!"
ChuYunfan was also spraying healing spray, and a refreshing feeling replaced the original burning feeling.
Liu Yushu was cruel to herself, even if her hands were bruised and covered with bloodstains, she would not stop. Naturally, it was not easy for him as a sparring partner to stop. Moreover, in such a battle, he had gained many benefits. Originally, he had just broken through and entered the realm of proficiency, but now he has become completely stable.
Now there are people who can accompany me in actual combat, provide healing sprays, and make money, so why not?
While fighting, he improved himself, and at the same time he had a very profound understanding. In the final analysis, although martial arts practice and martial arts are important, the state of internal strength is fundamental.
Although Liu Yushu suppressed her own energy, her physical fitness was much better than him. After Liu Yushu's Tiger Demon Fist also entered the realm of proficiency, she almost immediately resumed her suppression.
I could have found any loopholes to counterattack, but now I have lost all of them. What is left is a head-on confrontation, and in this regard, I am still far behind.
"I have not won any awards. I have hired a personal trainer before, but the personal trainer took leave today and did not come. I will fire him when I get back!" Liu Yushu said simply and directly, "My personal trainer's level is far inferior to yours. Although I was only one step away from being a private trainer to being a proficient one, but now it seems that without you as a sparring partner To take this step, it will take at least half a month. It will take a long time for my personal trainer to discover an obvious flaw in me. In front of you, I feel like I am undefended. All the flaws are exposed. Only by solving each flaw one by one can I make such rapid progress! "
